claude_proposed_widenings.name: weapon attachment variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic Weapon attaches to a nonmagical weapon (an object), not a creature. The surface Attachment type only has self/target/area/mark. V4 taxonomy already lists `weapon` as an attachment atom; the surface needs to expose it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_roll in RollKind
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell grants a bonus to damage rolls in addition to attack rolls. RollKind = 'attack_roll' | 'saving_throw' has no 'damage_roll' variant, so the operation cannot express the damage-roll half of the bonus.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: flat numeric delta in RollModifierOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: DiceDelta requires dice + dieSize (e.g. 1d4), designed for Bless-style bonuses. Magic Weapon grants a flat integer bonus (+1/+2/+3). There is no flat-numeric variant in the roll modifier operation; a FlatDelta or union with number is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: ...a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls. The bonus increases to +2... The bonus increases to +3...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: scalable delta on RollModifierOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The +1/+2/+3 bonus scales by slot tier (L2=+1, L3-5=+2, L6+=+3). RollModifierOperation.delta is a fixed DiceDelta with no scaling path. DiceAmount supports threshold_tiers scaling but only on damage effects; the roll-modifier operation needs an analogous ScalableBonus type.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: The bonus increases to +2 with a level 3-5 spell slot. The bonus increases to +3 with a level 6+ spell slot.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: replace_on_recast in Duration or lifecycle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell ends early when the caster casts it again. V4 has a replace_on_recast lifecycle atom but the surface Duration type only exposes instantaneous/concentration/timed — no early-termination-on-recast condition.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends early if you cast it again.
